newsAccuracy.note: One rater (Claude), 138 headlines, labels in tools/news-labels.json, scored by tools/news-score.mjs. 'Direction precision' = when the tool calls a headline good/bad for the tagged stock, how often that matches the label; 'recall' = how many truly directional headlines it caught. The honest figure is the holdout row; expect roughly 90% right on category and 70% on direction, so treat the arrow as a hint.
